properties.name: The one-graph vision is recorded as one requirement over its pieces; slice 3 is re-planned to carry decisions; a misattributed line is corrected
properties.rationale: Anthony restated the aim so that slice-level work is measured against it: "treat a set of projects... as 'one' design graph even though they are in separate designs (and probably different repos)". He asked why the agent had kept decisions out of slice 3, learned it was the agent's choice, and said "re-plan slice 3 to include Decisions". His /root-cause on why the vision looked scattered found that it mostly was not (13 of 16 records linked). The real gaps are the linking concept's narrow population, its pairwise shape, search that ignores links and a weak suggester (fact:root-cause-idea-linking-covers-open-ideas-in-pairs-and-a-vision-spread-across-requirements-is-never-gathered-2026-10-07).
properties.subject: record
properties.summary: req:a-set-of-designs-that-make-up-one-system-is-worked-as-one-design-graph is captured in Anthony's words, with seven existing requirements linked under it (DECOMPOSES). Slice 3's requirement, capability and acceptance check now cover decisions as well as requirements. A line the agent wrote under Anthony's 'RULED' heading in dec:idea-intent-crosses-designs ("a Decision node does not cross yet") is corrected as the agent's scoping, not his ruling. The root cause of why the vision read as scattered is recorded.
